description:
The load-bearing refactor. interactive.ex is already architected for this: handle_event/2 is a pure state machine and VirtualTerminal drives it without a TTY. The recursive receive loop is the only non-OTP part.

Changes:
- Add use GenServer; implement init/1, handle_info/2, terminate/2
- handle_loop_msg/5 clauses become handle_info/2 (mechanical rename; fsm/renderer/terminal move from args to state)
- Loader timeout: loop/4 'after @loader_interval_ms' becomes {:noreply, state, @loader_interval_ms} + handle_info(:timeout, state)
- EXIT handling: handle_info({:EXIT, pid, reason}, state) instead of trap_exit + pattern match in receive loop
- do_run/1 becomes init/1 + GenServer.start_link; run/1 stays as the public entry, calls GenServer.start_link then blocks (or just calls and supervises)

This ticket unblocks opi-gfy.4 (UIContext) and opi-gfy.5 (TUI supervision).
title: Interactive → GenServer
